_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or derived from extracted values by a rule stated beside it.

acres.basis: acres in the Taylor Technology Campus project

setback_nsw_ft.basis: feet buildings sit back from the north, east and west lines, at least

setback_south_ft.basis: feet data centers, generation and batteries sit back from the south line, at least

setback_accessory_ft.basis: feet accessory structures sit back from the south line, at least

buffer_ft.basis: feet of permanent landscaped buffer along the south line, at least

berm_ft.basis: feet high the earthen berms stand, at least

noise_with_dba.basis: dBA cap on the development's noise with the agreement, or the pre-development level if greater

noise_without_dba.basis: dBA state limit the city lists without the agreement

fill_million_gal.basis: million gallons in the cooling loop's initial fill, for the entire site

commit_total_m.basis: millions of dollars committed for community investments and nonprofit support

commit_city_m.basis: millions to the City of Taylor for quality-of-life improvements

commit_parks_min.basis: dollars at least for adaptive-use park improvements, inside the city's share

commit_isd_m.basis: millions to Taylor ISD educational programs

commit_cte_m.basis: millions for Taylor ISD career and technical education

internships_per_year.basis: student internships a year, at least

commit_animal_m.basis: millions for animal care program support

grant_each.basis: dollars in each of two initial nonprofit grants

grants_count.basis: nonprofits named for the initial grants
grants_count.rule: the two organisations c41 names, counted

nonprofit_annual_total_m.basis: millions in annual nonprofit contributions over the period

revenue_projection_b.basis: billions in gross tax revenue the CITY PROJECTS, a projection

revenue_years.basis: years of the city's revenue projection

pz_table_days.basis: days the Planning and Zoning Commission tabled the project

petition_signatures.basis: signatures the coalition gathered, about, as KEYE reports

test_start_hour.basis: hour generator tests may start, a.m.

test_end_hour.basis: hour generator tests must end, p.m.

commit_parts_sum_m.basis: the seven listed parts summed, millions

commit_isd_total_m.basis: millions to Taylor ISD across its three lines

commit_isd_share_pct.basis: percent of the committed total that goes to Taylor ISD
commit_isd_share_pct.rule: isd_total / total x 100, rounded to a whole percent

internships_total.basis: student internships at least, over the three years

noise_gap_dba.basis: dBA between the state limit the city lists and the agreement's cap

noise_power_ratio.basis: times the sound power a 20 dB difference stands for

test_window_hours.basis: hours in the weekday generator test window

site_side_m.basis: side in metres of a square of the site's area
site_side_m.rule: sqrt(m2), a square of equal area, NOT the parcel's shape

setback_nsw_m.basis: metres buildings sit back from the north, east and west lines, at least

setback_south_m.basis: metres data centers, generation and batteries sit back from the south line, at least

setback_accessory_m.basis: metres accessory structures sit back from the south line, at least

buffer_m.basis: metres of permanent landscaped buffer along the south line, at least

berm_m.basis: metres high the earthen berms stand, at least

fill_m3.basis: cubic metres in the initial fill

fill_cube_side_m.basis: side in metres of a cube holding the initial fill

days_to_vote.basis: days from this deck's date, October 6th, to the October 8th vote

drawn_depth_ft.basis: feet deep the fill basin is DRAWN, a drawing rule and not a claim, set equal to the berm height every stake in the deck stands at
drawn_depth_ft.label: drawing
